runs.description: Invocations the plugin infers, each a program and its arguments

applications.description: Bundle names of the applications the invocations install, a running executable inside one named in the last line as needing a relaunch

profiles.description: Patterns of the profiles the invocations write, each match removed before the invocations

objects.description: Instrumented binaries llvm-cov reads the coverage mapping of

results.description: Patterns of the result bundles the invocations write, each match removed before the invocations, the build product of each target xcrun xccov reports in one joining objects where the build wrote it

built.description: Workspace folders the builds write, the dependency and generated sources inside each left out of the report

mapping.description: Arguments each invocation ends with before <workspace root>/=, the coverage prefix map of a build reading no XCODE_XCCONFIG_FILE

file.description: File the lcov report is written to

report.description: lcov report written once every invocation passes: the profiles matching profiles merge with xcrun llvm-profdata merge, then export over objects and the targets of each matching result bundle with xcrun llvm-cov export, sources named from the workspace root

dryRun.description: Prints each invocation and runs none

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

outputs.description: Files the configuration writes, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}

title: Run
description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed and git status.branch off after the caller's GIT_CONFIG_<n> entries, stopping at the first failure, then writes the lcov report a coverage configuration states
